name: doc-accordion-item
purpose: One collapsible entry inside a `DocAccordionGroup`. It carries its title and its body only; the group owns the open-state model, the trigger and the panel. Rendered on its own it is a `display: contents` wrapper around its body.
avoidWhen: Outside a `DocAccordionGroup` — it renders no trigger of its own.
related: DocAccordionGroup` — the group that reads it.
bestPractices: Keep the title a question; keep the body prose.

props.name: title
props.doc: The question the trigger shows; `DocAccordionGroup` reads it to build the row.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Opens this entry on first render.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The answer shown when the entry is open.

examples.name: Default
